keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1363-1388: 'Mottama was in open rebellion from 1363 to 1388'. The pages name no leader and give no boundary; the Martaban province (Mon and Kayin in the gazetteer) is the whole of what they support. The Forty Years' War page has Razadarit 'taking Donwun by late 1388'.

notes: A rebel state written by the se-01-d agent because the hanthawaddy-kingdom ledger names it as counterpart (rule 5). It rests on two sentences from two pages; the rebels' leader, allies and seat are not on them, and the capital is assumed from the province name. A gap-filler with a source on Martaban in the 1360s-1380s (the Mon Yazawin, Harvey's History of Burma) should replace the thin shape. No page gives an area.
